verdict.rationale: AI-drafted replies are a fair question for an email service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents Fastmail drafting replies with AI, let alone in the user's own voice and tone. Templates and JMAP API building blocks are adjacent features or developer primitives, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
